issues.where: frames 4126-4183 across stars, left moon, rings, planet limb, and storm clouds
issues.what: fast dive and pitch-up motion has no shutter motion blur at all, leaving stars as 1-pixel pinpoints and thin rings and moon edges razor-sharp during 20-35 px/frame movement so fast motion strobes instead of blurring smoothly
issues.fix: enable continuous camera and object motion blur with enough temporal subsamples along the shutter interval so fast edges and point stars streak smoothly without discrete ghost copies

issues.where: frames 4393-4447 across sun, concentric rings, stars, moon, and receding globe
issues.what: rapid climb and pullback from terrain to space renders with zero motion blur, keeping thin ring arcs, stars, and cloud details pin-sharp across 25-45 px/frame displacements
issues.fix: apply smooth continuous shutter motion blur across the rise segment matching camera angular and radial velocity

issues.where: upper concentric ring arcs across consecutive frames 4180-4191 (and matching ring arcs in sheet-01.png and sheet-06.png)
issues.what: 1-pixel-thin bright ringlets stair-step and modulate in peak pixel brightness by ~20-25% from frame to frame as the curved arcs cross pixel rows, causing fine-line shimmer
issues.fix: supersample or pre-filter thin ring features in screen space with a slightly wider antialiased filter kernel so subpixel ring motion holds steady brightness
